name: What preparation is needed before flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a successful flooring installation. This typically involves clearing the room of furniture, removing existing flooring, and ensuring the subfloor is clean, dry, level, and structurally sound. Any necessary subfloor repairs, such as patching holes or leveling uneven areas, must be completed beforehand. Humidity and temperature in the room may also need to be regulated, especially for wood products, to allow for proper acclimation. Our team will guide you through all necessary steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes clearing furniture, removing old flooring, ensuring the subfloor is clean, dry, level, and performing any necessary repairs or acclimation.
